title: BM2382 ASIC 0xd0 · Configuration word
description: BM2382 ASIC 0xd0 · Configuration word. R: bit 0 retained directed changes. N: bit 30 was absent from rapid readback after set and clear writes. Readback alone does not distinguish masking, ignored writes and automatic clearing.
